convention: AZtec IPF colour keys supplied by the user
processing: Original colour-field samples are retained inside a one-pixel erosion of the cropped silhouette (RGB minimum <245, holes filled), excluding dark outline pixels (RGB maximum <240). Border/exterior pixels use the nearest retained colour sample to remove baked white/black matting before interpolation. Smooth SVG paths clip this padded RGB artwork to the original key outlines at preview/export resolution. Phase labels, Miller indices and overbars are rendered separately. This replaces the earlier binary alpha edge; no orientation-colouring algorithm is inferred.
